name: openclaw-remotion-video-pipeline
description: Open-source video workflow studio and Remotion render pipeline for Chinese short-form content

scripts.setup: npm --prefix remotion-video ci && npm --prefix video-pipeline-view/player-app ci
scripts.clean: npm run remotion-video:clean:runtime && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const target of ['video-pipeline-view/player-app/dist','video-pipeline-view/player-app/.vite','remotion-video/out','remotion-video/dist']) fs.rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true});"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix video-pipeline-view/player-app run typecheck && npm --prefix remotion-video run typecheck && node --check remotion-video/server/api/server.js && node --check remotion-video/server/workers/renderWorker.js && node --check remotion-video/server/workflow/skillRegistry.js && node --check remotion-video/server/workflow/step123/pipeline.js
scripts.release:check: npm run clean && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run remotion-video:clean:runtime && node remotion-video/scripts/clean-runtime.mjs --check
